deadline.value: Doctoral applications for fall entry should reach admissions by February 15; the catalog says applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student gets an academic advisor after admission; the catalog does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.
supervisor.quote: All students pursuing a doctoral degree will have an academic advisor (and co-advisor, if applicable) who must be a member of the Missouri S&T graduate faculty.

funding.value: Teaching assistantships are competitively awarded to excellent applicants with an identified faculty mentor.
funding.quote: Competitively awarded graduate teaching assistantships are available for excellent applicants with an identified faculty mentor

entry_route.value: A student with a B.S. who pursues the PhD completes 72 credit hours, including 30 hours of research.
entry_route.quote: A student holding a B.S. degree and pursuing a Ph.D. in biological sciences will complete a total of 72 credit hours including a minimum of 30 credit hours in graduate course work and a minimum of 30 hours of research credit

notes: The PhD has a Biomedicine track, so biomed is listed as also_fields. Department PhD pages on the mst.edu subdomains could not be reached (TLS verification failure through the proxy); this record uses the graduate catalog only.
